[EN] Researchers insist that Jirash halt the attacks of {@LinkCreature:13#2#sporewalkers} on their supplies. Adria commands that all sentries stay at their posts.

Those who are neither researchers nor sentries can still be of assistance. The spirits seek mana crystals, which were taken from other spirits.

Reclaim as many crystals as possible and bring them here.
[ES] Los investigadores insisten en que Jirash detenga los ataques de los {@LinkCreature:13#2#sporewalkers} a sus suministros. Adria ordena que todos los centinelas permanezcan en sus puestos.

Aquellos que no son ni investigadores ni centinelas aún pueden ser de ayuda. Los espíritus buscan crystals, que fueron tomados de otros espíritus.

Reclaim tantos crystals como sea posible y tráelos aquí.

[EN] Precisely what they wanted. Researchers and sentries alike celebrate! Perhaps now Jirash can join the real fight—wherever it is you are going.
[ES] Precisamente lo que querían. ¡Investigadores y centinelas por igual celebran! Tal vez ahora Jirash pueda unirse a la verdadera lucha, dondequiera que vayas.

[EN] The {@LinkCreature:13#2#sporewalkers} are directly below. Be wary of their arms. Spinning, slamming, and striking heavy blows to the unwary. Perhaps the recruit knows this already, since there are no mana crystals to return yet.

Seek them out, and bring them back. Returning before then is pointless.
[ES] Los {@LinkCreature:13#2#sporewalkers} están justo abajo. Cuidado con sus brazos. Girando, golpeando y asestando fuertes golpes a los descuidados. Tal vez el recluta ya sepa esto, ya que aún no hay MP crystals que devolver.

Búscalos y tráelos de vuelta. Regresar antes de eso no tiene sentido.
